primaryChecks.text: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ヨシュアの墓所がエフライム山地にあると記す。初出の場所説明。

primaryChecks.text: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.
primaryChecks.roleJa: エフドはエフライム山地で角笛を吹き、そこからイスラエルの人々が下った。

primaryChecks.text: She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her for judgment.
primaryChecks.roleJa: デボラのなつめやしの木はラマとベテルの間、エフライム山地にあった。

primaryChecks.text: Those whose root is in Amalek came out of Ephraim, after you, Benjamin, among your peoples. Governors come down out of Machir. Those who handle the marshal’s staff came out of Zebulun.
primaryChecks.roleJa: 歌はエフライムから来た人々・部隊の出発を述べる地理的表現。部族の人々そのものとは区別。

primaryChecks.text: Gideon sent messengers throughout all the hill country of Ephraim, saying, “Come down against Midian and take the waters before them as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan!” So all the men of Ephraim were gathered together and took the waters as far as Beth Barah, even the Jordan.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ギデオンはエフライム山地へ使者を送り、ヨルダンの渡河点を守るよう求めた。

primaryChecks.text: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.
primaryChecks.roleJa: トラはエフライム山地のシャミルに住んだと記す。

primaryChecks.text: Then Jephthah gathered together all the men of Gilead, and fought with Ephraim. The men of Gilead struck Ephraim, because they said, “You are fugitives of Ephraim, you Gileadites, in the middle of Ephraim, and in the middle of Manasseh.”
primaryChecks.roleJa: エフタの発言に「エフライムとマナセの中」という地域的な位置表現がある。

primaryChecks.text: Abdon the son of Hillel the Pirathonite died, and was buried in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill country of the Amalekites.
primaryChecks.roleJa: アブドンはエフライムの地、アマレク人の山地に葬られた。

primaryChecks.text: There was a man of the hill country of Ephraim, whose name was Micah.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ミカはエフライム山地の人として初登場する。

primaryChecks.text: The man departed out of the city, out of Bethlehem Judah, to live where he could find a place, and he came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, as he traveled.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ベツレヘムから来たレビ人はエフライム山地のミカの家へ到着した。

primaryChecks.text: The children of Dan sent five men of their family from their whole number, men of valor, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to spy out the land and to search it. They said to them, “Go, explore the land!” They came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, and lodged there.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ダン人の斥候はエフライム山地にあるミカの家で宿泊した。

primaryChecks.text: They passed from there to the hill country of Ephraim, and came to the house of Micah.
primaryChecks.roleJa: 斥候たちはミカの家へ向かう途上でエフライム山地を通った。

primaryChecks.text: In those days, when there was no king in Israel, there was a certain Levite living on the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim, who took for himself a concubine out of Bethlehem Judah.
primaryChecks.roleJa: レビ人はエフライム山地の奥に住んでいた。

primaryChecks.text: Behold, an old man came from his work out of the field at evening. Now the man was from the hill country of Ephraim, and he lived in Gibeah; but the men of the place were Benjamites.
primaryChecks.roleJa: ギブアの老人はエフライム山地出身と説明される。

primaryChecks.text: He said to him, “We are passing from Bethlehem Judah to the farther side of the hill country of Ephraim. I am from there, and I went to Bethlehem Judah. I am going to the LORD’s house; and there is no one who has taken me into his house.
primaryChecks.roleJa: 旅人はベツレヘムからエフライム山地へ向かう途中だと説明する。

primaryChecks.text: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: この節のEphraimはCanaanitesを追い出す主体で、部族・人々を指す。

primaryChecks.text: The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「men of Ephraim」はギデオンを責める人々で、土地・地域名ではない。

primaryChecks.text: He said to them, “What have I now done in comparison with you? Isn’t the gleaning of the grapes of Ephraim better than the vintage of Abiezer?
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「Ephraimのぶどうの収穫」はギデオンの言葉の中の部族・人々を指す比喩で、地理的地域を直接指さない。

primaryChecks.text: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「house of Ephraim」はアモン人と戦う集団で、地理的地域の用例ではない。

primaryChecks.text: The men of Ephraim were gathered together, and passed northward; and they said to Jephthah, “Why did you pass over to fight against the children of Ammon, and didn’t call us to go with you? We will burn your house around you with fire!”
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「men of Ephraim」はエフタへ抗議に来た人々。

primaryChecks.text: The Gileadites took the fords of the Jordan against the Ephraimites. Whenever a fugitive of Ephraim said, “Let me go over,” the men of Gilead said to him, “Are you an Ephraimite?” If he said, “No;”
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「fugitive of Ephraim」「Ephraimite」は個人の所属を問う語。

primaryChecks.text: then they said to him, “Now say ‘Shibboleth;’” and he said “Sibboleth”; for he couldn’t manage to pronounce it correctly, then they seized him and killed him at the fords of the Jordan. At that time, forty-two thousand of Ephraim fell.
primaryChecks.reasonJa: 「Ephraim fell」は戦死した部族の人々を指す。
